name: dowiz-watch

description.en: An independent Worker probes production from inside Cloudflare every 5 minutes, keeps the last result per target, mails the operator on down/up transitions, and serves /status and /healthz on workers.dev, where GitHub's heartbeat reads it outside Bot Fight Mode.
description.uk: Незалежний Worker кожні 5 хвилин перевіряє продакшен зсередини Cloudflare, пише листа оператору на кожну зміну стану і віддає /status та /healthz на workers.dev, де їх читає heartbeat з GitHub.

producer.what: tick(): probes -> WatchState.record -> mail on transitions

consumer.what: reads /healthz and /status every 10 min; health-cron.yml prints the table every 15 min

external.service: Cloudflare Workers (cron trigger, SQLite Durable Object, Email Routing send_email)

auth.where: no secret: the mail binding's destination is the address already verified for the waitlist (syniaksviatoslav@proton.me)

schema_status: from the code; validate against the first live answer
probe: After deploy: one real tick (lastTickMs set, 13 targets); /status read from the box and from one heartbeat workflow_dispatch run; RED: deploy with EXTRA_TARGETS qa-404=https://qa-durres.dowiz.org/healthz-404, next tick shows lastMail {changes:['qa-404: unknown -> down'], ok:true|false+error}; redeploy without it.
